' 19 S. -'010 MR. VICTOR C. REYES President, Pambansang Pederasyon Ng Liga Ng Mga Barangay (PPLB) MR. JOHN CARLO L. VILLASIN President, Pambayang Pederasyon ng Sangguniang Kabataan (PPSK) Atimonan, Quezon Gentlemen: This has reference to your letter dated 01 July 2010 seeking any immediate relief and/or remedy to invalidate the Unnumbered Executive Order issued by Municipal Mayor Jose F. Mendoza on 17 May 2010 declaring both of you deemed resigned upon the filing of your Certificate of Candidacy on 29 November 2009. In the Unnumbered Executive Order which was attached to your letter, Mayor Mendoza directed Punong Barangay Ernesto Villasin and SK Chairman Geoffrey Encanto, Vice Presidents of the respective associations abovementioned, to take their oath of office and assume the positions previously occupied by Messrs. Reyes and Villasin, that is, as Ex-Officio Members of the Sangguniang Bayan of Atimonan. Furthermore, Mayor Mendoza directed both of you to return all salaries and benefits received from the Municipal Government of Atimonan reckoned from the date of the filing of your Certificates of Candidacy. Acting on the foregoing request, we first tackle on the most apparent issue brought before this Department for resolution, that is, the remedy of invalidating an Executive Order issued by Municipal Mayor Mendoza and to further issue an order directing the said local chief executive to recognize the authority of this Department over the issue. On this issue alone, please be informed that this Department does not have the power and authority to invalidate an Executive Order issued by a local chief executive. Should you wish to further seek this remedy, it is proposed that an action be filed within the proper court having jurisdiction over the subject matter.

As to the other glaring issues intimately related to and contained in the assailed Unnumbered Executive Order of Mayor Mendoza, and pursuant to this Department's authority asa general supervisor of the local government units, we take into consideration the issue of compliance by Mayor Mendoza to the laws and issuances governing the Local Government, to wit: 1. Whether Messrs. Reyes and Villasin are deemed resigned or not upon the filing of the Certificate of Candidacy on 29 November 2002? 2. Whether the assumption to office by Punong Barangay Villasin and SK Chairman Encanto as Ex-Officio Members of Municipal Council replacing Messrs. Reyes and Villasin is proper or not? On the first-mentioned issue, we are of the view that you are not deemed resigned upon the filing of your Certificates of Candidacy on 29 November 2009 for the 2010 Automated National and Local Elections. The present state of the law holds that 'any person holding an elective office or position sha// not be considered resigned upon the filing of his certificate of candidacy for the same or any other e/ective office or positiod. This was enunciated in the case of Quinto vs COMELEC, G.R. No. 189698, 01 December 2009, which validates Section 4(b) of COMELEC Resolution No. 8678 promulgated on 06 October 2009. Ergo, both of you remain as elective officials, being the incumbent Punong Barangay of Lubi, Atimonan, Quezon and SK Chairman of Barangay Angeles, Atimonan, Quezon, respectively. There being no vacancy on these posts, there was no legal basis for the mode of succession to take place, particularly for the Vice Presidents of these association to assume the offices subject of this query. This takes us to the last-mentioned issue. We find that the assumption to office of replacements Punong Barangay Villasin and SK Chairman Encanto, Vice Presidents of PPLB and PPSK respectively, is not proper and the same is contrary to law. The pertinent provisions in the Local Government Code of 1991, particularly Section 446 (Sangguniang Bayan) and Section 495 apply, and we quote: "Section 446. Composition. - (a) The sangguniang bayan, the legislative body of the municipality, shall be composed of the munictpal vice mayor as the presiding officer, the regular sanggunian members, the president of the municipal chapter of the liga ng mga barangay, the president of the pambayang pederasyon ng mga sangguniang kabataan, and the sectoral representatives, as mentbers. " Section 494. Ex-Officio Membership in Sanggunians. The duly elected presidents of the liga at the municipal, city and provincial levels, including the contponent cities and municipalities q/' Metropolitan Manila, shall serve as ex-officio members of the sangqunianq bayan, tggu tg panlungsod, 2

sangguniang panlalawigan, respectively. They shall serve as such only during their tenn of ojJice as presidents of the liga chapters, which in no case shall be beyond the term of office of the sanggunian concerned. (emphasis and underscoring supplied) As mentioned above, you were not considered resigned from your elective posts. There being no showing that you were removed as Presidents of your respective associations, you must continue to discharge the functions of your offices and representation in the Sangguniang Bayan of Atimonan, Quezon as mandated. This Department notes the existence of \Kapasiyahan Blg. 0-10' of PPLB — Quezon Chapter certified by PPLB President Macario D. Boongaling and PPLB Secretary Camila Mercado expressing the said liga's support for the incumbency of Messrs. Victor C. Reyes and John Carlo L. Villasin. We hope that we have sufficiently addressed your concerns. Very truly yours, By Authority of the Secretary: Director III LS:55/ins B. DO UE I v 3
